To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) double Higgs production is a very important process at the Linear Collider, (ii) the cross sections are large, (iii) they are sensitive to the triple Higgs coupling, (iv) they can be measured at the Linear Collider with high precision.
the processes e+e− → h°h°Z and e+e− -> A°h°h° are the best channels to measure the triple Higgs coupling λ3, while e+e−-> h°h°h0 is the best channel to measure the coupling λ5.
the processes e+e− →h °hA and e+e− → A0A0Z, where h ° and A0 are the lightest Higgs scalars, are the best channels for measuring the triple Higgs coupling h °A0h ° at the Linear Collider.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the double Higgs production at the linear collider in the framework of 2HDM.
the study of the double Higgs production in Two Higgs Doublets Models at the future Linear e+e− Colliders.
the study of the production of two Higgs bosons in association with Z boson at future linear collider, with emphasis on the Two Higgs doublet model.

the study of the double Higgs production at the future linear collider is a promising tool for the investigation of the Higgs potential and for the reconstruction of the Higgs sector of the theory.
the double Higgs production processes at the Linear Collider provide a very good chance to study the scalar sector of the Two Higg Doublet Model.
